headerDisplay: Matter-native Homebridge plugin for the Xiaomi Robot Vacuum S12 (xiaomi.vacuum.b106eu). Requires Homebridge 2.0+ with Matter enabled.
footerDisplay: For help and documentation, visit the [project repository](https://github.com/garlik82/homebridge-xiaomi-s12-vacuum).

name.title: Name
name.description: The name that will appear in Homebridge and the Home app.

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: The local IP address of your vacuum. A static/reserved DHCP lease is strongly recommended.

token.title: Token
token.description: The 32-character local MIoT token. Extract it with a tool such as the Xiaomi Cloud Tokens Extractor.

deviceId.title: Device ID (DID)
deviceId.description: The numeric device ID (DID) of your vacuum.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to perform a full vacuum refresh. Core state changes made in Mi Home are also checked every 5 seconds; commands trigger an additional fast refresh.

connectAttempts.title: Connection Attempts
connectAttempts.description: How many local UDP retries to make before giving up on a command or status read.

requestTimeout.title: Local Request Timeout (milliseconds)
requestTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a local vacuum request before resetting the connection and retrying.

matterUpdateTimeout.title: Matter State Update Timeout (milliseconds)
matterUpdateTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for Homebridge/Matter state updates before treating the refresh as failed.

statusUpdateWatchdog.title: Status Update Watchdog (milliseconds)
statusUpdateWatchdog.description: Maximum time a status refresh may stay in progress before a later poll is allowed to recover.

enableConsumableLogs.title: Log Consumable Status
enableConsumableLogs.description: Log filter and brush life when values change.

lowConsumableThreshold.title: Low Consumable Warning Threshold (%)
lowConsumableThreshold.description: Warn when filter or brush life is at or below this percentage.

enableRoomCleaning.title: Enable Room Cleaning (experimental)
enableRoomCleaning.description: Expose configured rooms as Matter service areas so you can start per-room cleaning from the Home app.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: The rooms defined on your vacuum's map. Room IDs are device-specific and usually start at 10.
